statements.quote: I also support commonsense AI safeguards to protect children interacting with chat bots and make sure the newest models don’t pose major risks to our cybersecurity.

statements.quote: I believe AI has real potential to improve lives – but it also comes with real risks and shouldn’t involve giving Big Tech a blank check. AI should work for all of us, not just for the companies building it.

statements.source_label: Zach Dembo for Congress, 'Commonsense Regulation for AI and Data Centers'
